Title: Nitin and the Family

Cast

1. Nitin - 29 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anita - 30 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Vinod - 29 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Sonali - 30 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
5. Sunita - 56 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The village well - Day

[Nitin stands by the well. Anita and Sunita stand near him.]

Nitin: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nitin draws water from the well with the rope.]

Anita: "I'm ready!"

[Nitin drinks water from his cupped hands.]

Nitin: "Let's see."

[Nitin splashes water on his face at the well.]

Nitin: "Okay, Mom."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Nitin stands by the road. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Nitin rides his motorbike to the market.]

Nitin (excited): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nitin starts his scooter and rides off.]

Nitin: "And then?"

[Nitin drives the car to the office.]

Anita: "Show me too!"

[Nitin gets out of the car.]

Nitin: "Really?"

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

[Anita stands on the terrace. Nitin stands near her.]

Nitin: "Anita, look over here."

[Anita hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Anita (happily): "Well done!"

[Nitin ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Nitin: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nitin reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Nitin (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nitin falls from the ladder and hurts his leg.]

Nitin: "And then?"

[Nitin falls from the roof and dies.]

Anita: "We have to be strong now."
